title: Remotion Superpowers: video studio plugin for Claude Code
blender-skills: Blender 3D workflows as agent skills
Sci-fi exploration ship in a gas storm
prompt_text: An exploration ship maneuvers through a vast cloud of charged gas and floating debris. Inside the cockpit, the pilot moves the controls while the captain braces against the console and an alien crew member monitors the storm. The camera moves from the crew toward the forward window, cinematic tension, realistic motion.
